body:
> Additionally, it would be nice if we could forward-declare SceneTreeFTI in scene_tree.h and move the include to the .cpp, but currently it's added as a full member so we can't. Could it be made a pointer?

Not altogether convinced it will be worth it. 
:thinking: 

If you look at `scene_tree_fti.h` it's not a heavy include (forward declares most) and just includes `local_vector` and `mutex`. `mutex` _could_ be worth avoiding, but you may find it's already included in 99% cases so no win (it could well be included by one of the other templates node uses). There are other ways we could avoid including mutex here if you think it will be a problem (e.g. making it dynamically allocated in the cpp).

`Node::is_physics_interpolated_and_enabled` does get hammered quite a bit so inlining is probably useful, however go ahead with the PR and ping me afterwards, I'm sure I can move the bool for `is_fti_enabled()` to a static on the `Node` so there's no dependency on `SceneTree`. I likely put it there in the first place because of the dependency already existing to scene tree, and scene tree being a slightly more logical place to put it, but it would be fine on `Node` too.
